opportunities.publisher: Plan International Latin America and the Caribbean
opportunities.description:
Organización: Plan International

Puesto: Project Coordinator

Duración: 6 meses

Ubicación: Venezuela, con desplazamientos a zonas de intervención según necesidad y condiciones de seguridad Tipo de contrato
Contrato: temporal / consultoría, según modalidad aplicable

Inicio estimado: Lo antes posible

1. Contexto
Plan International busca contratar a un/a Project Coordinator para coordinar la implementación de un proyecto de respuesta humanitaria en Venezuela, orientado a atender necesidades urgentes de niñas, niños, adolescentes, mujeres y familias afectadas por la emergencia. El proyecto se implementará mediante un modelo de trabajo con organizaciones locales socias, con actividades multisectoriales vinculadas a protección, apoyo psicosocial, salud, salud sexual y reproductiva, asistencia básica y coordinación comunitaria.
El/la Project Coordinator será responsable de asegurar que la intervención avance de forma ordenada, segura, coordinada y alineada con los estándares humanitarios, las políticas de Plan International y los compromisos del proyecto.

2. Objetivo del puesto
Coordinar la planificación, implementación, seguimiento y reporte del proyecto, asegurando una articulación efectiva entre Plan International, las organizaciones socias, los equipos técnicos y las funciones de soporte. El puesto deberá garantizar calidad programática, cumplimiento, gestión de riesgos, rendición de cuentas y una implementación centrada en la niñez, la protección y la dignidad de las personas afectadas.

3. Responsabilidades principales
•
Coordinar la ejecución diaria del proyecto, dando seguimiento al plan de trabajo, cronograma, presupuesto, indicadores y entregables.
•
Facilitar reuniones periódicas de seguimiento con las organizaciones socias, equipos técnicos y áreas de soporte, documentando acuerdos, acciones y responsables.
•
Asegurar que las actividades se implementen de acuerdo con los estándares de Plan International, principios humanitarios, enfoque de no hacer daño, salvaguarda y rendición de cuentas.
•
Acompañar a las organizaciones socias en la planificación operativa, seguimiento de actividades, reporte narrativo y financiero, gestión documental y resolución de cuellos de botella.
•
Coordinar con los equipos técnicos la calidad de las actividades de protección, apoyo psicosocial, salud, salud sexual y reproductiva, asistencia básica y referencias.
•
Dar seguimiento al avance presupuestario, forecast, solicitudes de fondos, documentación de respaldo y cumplimiento de requisitos contractuales.
•
Consolidar información semanal y mensual para reportes internos, actualizaciones de situación, reportes a donantes y espacios de coordinación externa.
•
Apoyar la implementación de herramientas de monitoreo, evaluación, aprendizaje, mecanismos de feedback comunitario y seguimiento post-distribución cuando aplique.
Plan International | Términos de Referencia
Documento para publicación interna/externa – Project Coordinator, Venezuela
•
Identificar, monitorear y elevar riesgos operativos, de seguridad, acceso, cumplimiento, salvaguarda, protección de datos o reputación institucional.
•
Coordinar el mapeo de actividades, zonas de intervención, actores relevantes y rutas de referencia para evitar duplicidades y fortalecer complementariedad.
•
Apoyar la documentación de aprendizajes, buenas prácticas, historias de cambio y materiales de comunicación, asegurando consentimiento informado y estándares de salvaguarda.

4. Entregables esperados
•
Plan operativo del proyecto actualizado, con cronograma, responsables, ubicaciones y metas.
•
Matriz de seguimiento de actividades, indicadores, riesgos, presupuesto y acciones pendientes.
•
Reportes periódicos narrativos y de avance para Plan International y donantes, según requerimiento.
•
Actualización regular del forecast, ejecución presupuestaria y necesidades operativas.
•
Registro de reuniones, decisiones, acuerdos y seguimiento con organizaciones socias.
•
Mapeo actualizado de intervenciones, rutas de referencia, actores clave y complementariedad.
•
Informe final del proyecto con resultados, desafíos, aprendizajes y recomendaciones.

5. Perfil requerido
Formación
•
Título universitario en cooperación internacional, ciencias sociales, gestión de proyectos, acción humanitaria, salud pública, protección, desarrollo o áreas afines.
•
Formación complementaria en gestión de proyectos humanitarios, MEAL, protección, salvaguarda, grants, salud/SRHR o coordinación humanitaria será valorada.
Experiencia
•
Mínimo 5 años de experiencia en coordinación o gestión de proyectos humanitarios o de desarrollo.
•
Experiencia en respuestas de emergencia, implementación con organizaciones socias y coordinación multisectorial.
•
Experiencia en seguimiento presupuestario, reportes a donantes, cumplimiento contractual y gestión documental.
•
Experiencia aplicando enfoques de salvaguarda, PSEAH, protección, género, inclusión, AAP y protección de datos.
Competencias
•
Excelente capacidad de organización, coordinación, comunicación y seguimiento.
•
Habilidad para trabajar bajo presión, priorizar y resolver problemas de forma práctica.
•
Capacidad para construir relaciones de confianza con equipos, socios y actores externos.
•
Buena redacción en español; inglés deseable para coordinación regional y reportes internos.
•
Manejo de herramientas Office, Excel, Teams/SharePoint y plataformas de recolección de datos como Kobo/COBO o similares.

6. Salvaguarda y conducta
La persona seleccionada deberá cumplir estrictamente con las políticas de Plan International sobre salvaguarda, protección infantil, PSEAH, código de conducta, protección de datos, conflicto de interés y prevención de fraude. Deberá promover un entorno seguro, respetuoso e inclusivo para niñas, niños, adolescentes, comunidades, equipos y organizaciones socias.

7. Criterios de éxito
•
Implementación oportuna y ordenada del plan de trabajo.
•
Coordinación fluida entre Plan International, organizaciones socias y equipos técnicos.
•
Reportes completos, claros y entregados dentro de los plazos establecidos.
•
Seguimiento efectivo del presupuesto, riesgos, indicadores y compromisos contractuales.
•
Aplicación consistente de estándares de calidad, salvaguarda, rendición de cuentas y no hacer daño.

opportunities.title: Communications Advisor
opportunities.description:
About the Australia-Pacific Partnerships Platform

The Australia-Pacific Partnerships Platform is an Australian Government initiative funded by the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) and managed by DT Global. It provides Pacific Countries with a suite of flexible, fit-for-purpose options that support broad governance and stable development outcomes.

About DT Global

At DT Global Asia Pacific, we aim to positively impact people’s lives through delivery excellence. As a leading implementing partner across Asia and the Pacific, we co-create locally led solutions in partnership with governments, communities, and stakeholders. We bring together talented teams and deep regional expertise to deliver initiatives that promote inclusive economic growth, essential services, and resilient, secure communities. With over 1,500 staff, experts in 22+ countries and more than 60 years of development experience, we tackle complex community, national and transnational challenges — from governance and justice systems to climate resilience, infrastructure and social equity — with innovative thinking and a commitment to long-term impact.

For more information, please see www.dt-global.com

About the Role

The Australia-Pacific Partnerships Platform is seeking a suitably qualified individual or communications services provider to strengthen the visibility, influence, and impact of the Platform and its country programs across the Pacific. Working closely with the Senior Communications Officer and broader program team, the consultant/provider will deliver strategic communications advice and hands-on communications support, including content development, stakeholder engagement, public diplomacy communications, graphic design, and visual storytelling.

The role will support the development and implementation of communications strategies, production of high-quality communications and knowledge products, and the creation of engaging visual and multimedia content that showcases development outcomes and impact. The consultant/provider will contribute to strengthening the Platform's communications function through strategic guidance, responsive communications support, and the delivery of consistent, high-quality communications products across the Platform and its country programs.

Click on the link or copy paste it to access the full Terms of Reference and Selection Criteria for this position: https://tinyurl.com/bdp23yb6

About You

This role requires an experienced communications professional with expertise in strategic communications, public relations, graphic and visual design, and communications advisory services. You will have demonstrated experience delivering communications support for government, international development organisations, or donor-funded programs, including developing communications strategies, creating high-quality content and visual products, and engaging diverse stakeholders. Strong project management skills, excellent written and visual communication abilities, and experience working collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams are essential. Experience with DFAT-funded programs, Pacific development contexts, and public diplomacy communications will be highly regard.

opportunities.title: Liaison Officer
opportunities.description:
EMERGENCY NGO is an international non-governmental organization established in 1994 to provide free, high-quality medical and surgical care to victims of war, landmines, and poverty, while promoting a culture of peace, solidarity, and respect for human rights. Since its foundation, EMERGENCY has treated more than 11 million patients worldwide. The organization currently operates also in Afghanistan, Ethiopia, Gaza, Iraq, Italy (incl. Search and Rescue in Mediterranean Sea), Sierra Leone, Sudan, Ukraine, Uganda.

EMERGENCY is founded on the principle that access to high-quality healthcare is a fundamental human right.

The Al Rastan Hospital, Syria, will be a healthcare facility dedicated to providing free, high-quality medical services to vulnerable populations. The hospital will aim to ensure equitable access to healthcare while contributing to the strengthening of local health services and fostering a culture of dignity, respect, and human rights.

Position: Liaison Officer

Reporting Line: Operations Manager/Programme Coordinator

Scope of the Position

The Liaison Officer is based at EMERGENCY’s facilities in Syria and acts as the primary focal point for all institutional relations and governmental engagement, administrative coordination, and contextual analysis.

The role operates under the direct supervision and strategic guidance of the Operations Manager/Programme Coordinator, ensuring that all external engagement and relationship-building efforts are fully aligned with organizational priorities and programmatic objectives.

The position plays a critical role in enabling the effective and compliant implementation of EMERGENCY’s activities in Syria through the development and maintenance of constructive relationships with governmental authorities, local institutions, and relevant stakeholders. The Liaison Officer also provides continuous support in matters related to access, security, regulatory compliance, and external representation, ensuring that all operations are conducted in accordance with national regulations and organizational policies.

Key Responsibilities

The Liaison Officer's responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

Context Monitoring and Analysis

  • Continuously monitor and analyse political, security, administrative, and socio-economic developments relevant to EMERGENCY’s activities in Syria.
  • Provide timely and accurate updates, assessments, and recommendations to the Operations Manager/Programme Coordinator regarding developments that may affect operational continuity, access, or project implementation.
  • Support the development of risk mitigation strategies by contributing contextual analysis and stakeholder mapping.

Institutional and Government Relations

  • Establish, maintain, and strengthen professional relationships with relevant Syrian authorities at national, regional, and local levels, including but not limited to ministries, health authorities, local administrations, and regulatory bodies.
  • Represent EMERGENCY in meetings with governmental institutions and external stakeholders, as delegated by the Operations Manager/Programme Coordinator.
  • Facilitate constructive dialogue and cooperation between EMERGENCY and relevant authorities to support the successful implementation of program activities.

Regulatory Compliance and Legal Documentation

  • Ensure the timely preparation, submission, renewal, and follow-up of all documentation required for the legal and administrative operation of EMERGENCY projects in Syria.
  • Coordinate and monitor processes related to Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs), operational agreements, registrations, authorizations, exemptions, licenses, and any other official documentation required by Syrian authorities.
  • Maintain accurate records and ensure compliance with all applicable national regulations and organizational procedures.

Visa, Residency, and Travel Authorization Management

  • Oversee and coordinate all procedures related to entry visas, residency permits, work permits, travel authorizations, and other immigration-related requirements for international staff.
  • Liaise proactively with the relevant authorities to ensure that documentation is processed efficiently and within required timelines.
  • Anticipate potential administrative challenges and develop appropriate solutions to minimize operational disruptions.

Professional Registration and Accreditation

  • Facilitate and monitor procedures related to professional registrations, medical licenses, accreditation requirements, and other regulatory obligations applicable to international and national health personnel.
  • Ensure compliance with the requirements of relevant professional councils, ministries, and regulatory institutions.

Translation and Administrative Support

  • Provide high-quality interpretation and translation services during official meetings, negotiations, and interactions with external stakeholders.
  • Translate official correspondence, agreements, legal documents, reports, and other relevant materials between Arabic and English, ensuring accuracy and consistency of terminology.
  • Support the Operations Manager/Programme Coordinator in the preparation and review of official communications and institutional documentation.

Stakeholder Engagement and Operational Support

  • Support the Operations Manager/Programme Coordinator in maintaining effective relationships with suppliers, service providers, community representatives, and other strategic stakeholders.
  • Conduct market assessments and stakeholder mapping when requested, providing relevant information to support operational and administrative decision-making.
  • Contribute to ensuring a positive representation of EMERGENCY NGO among institutional counterparts and external partners.

Official Correspondence

  • Draft, review, and manage official letters, notes verbales, administrative documents, and formal communications in both Arabic and English.
  • Ensure that all correspondence reflects EMERGENCY’s standards of professionalism, neutrality, and institutional integrity.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Education in Political Science, International Relations, Public Administration, Law, Business Administration, or a related field is considered an asset
  • Demonstrated experience in liaison, government relations, public administration, humanitarian operations, or a similar role within international organizations, NGOs, or public institutions.
  • Excellent interpersonal, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong understanding of the Syrian institutional, political, and administrative environment.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a complex and rapidly evolving humanitarian context.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Arabic and English.
  • Strong organizational skills with a high level of attention to detail.
  • Ability to handle sensitive, confidential, and politically delicate information with discretion and professionalism.
  • Demonstrated commitment to humanitarian principles, neutrality, and respect for cultural diversity.

Core Competencies

  • Professional integrity and ethical conduct.
  • Diplomacy and relationship-building.
  • Strategic thinking and problem-solving.
  • Accountability, reliability and adaptability.
  • Ability to work independently while maintaining strong coordination with multidisciplinary teams.

opportunities.title: Finance Controller - International (HQ)
opportunities.description:
INTERSOS is an independent humanitarian organization that assists the victims of natural disasters, armed conflicts and exclusion. Its activities are based on the principles of solidarity, justice, human dignity, equality of rights and opportunities, respect for diversity and coexistence, paying special attention to the most vulnerable people.

Terms of reference

Job Title: Finance Controller - International

Code: SR-00-10257

Duty station: Home based - HQ with possible field missions

Starting date: 01/09/2026

Contract duration: 12 months (renewable)

Reporting to: Referent: Finance Director

Functional Supervisor: Technical referent: International Finance Coordinator

Supervision of: NA

Type of Duty Station: Non-family duty station

General context of the project

INTERSOS is a humanitarian organization operating in major global emergencies. The Finance Department serves as a core pillar for programmatic activities, supporting, monitoring, and analyzing the key economic and financial sustainability factors of the Organization. The selected candidate will play a central role in these strategic efforts.

General purpose of the position

The International Finance Controller supports the mission's financial reporting process within the organization. Collaborates with the finance department to ensure effective foreign accounting financial reporting and alignment with all financial regulations and procedures.

Collaborates with the Finance Coordinator - International and the Archive & docs Officer to ensure process consistency.

Delivers training on the use of the accounting system to the finance staff.

Main responsibilities and tasks:

Accounting & Financial Statements

  • Ensure the regular technical update and synchronization of foreign accounting in the accounting software on a monthly basis.
  • Lead and coordinate the preparation of consolidated financial statements relating to projects and missions, ensuring completion by the second quarter of the following year.
  • Collaborate with the Finance Director on HQ audit activities, acting as a technical point of contact to respond to queries from external auditors.
  • Liaise and work in coordination with various teams to perform financial analysis and draft intermediate reports summarizing foreign accounting data.
  • Analyze and conduct studies to evaluate financial actions, recommending adjustments to accounting processes, and providing technical advice and improvements.
  • Support and facilitate the alignment of financial processes and accounting system rules across departments (HQ and Region), providing technical guidance to the INTERSOS Regional Team on system usage.

Accounting System

In collaboration with the software developer:

  • Review, refine, and support the implementation of procedures aimed at streamlining the accounting system.
  • Assess and identify gaps between department requirements and the accounting system, defining functional and workable solutions to bridge them.
  • Evaluate and report on the performance of the accounting system.
  • Design, organize, and deliver training on the accounting system for both financial and non-financial staff.
  • Collaborate with the Finance Director in designing and developing new processes and tools to track and analyze accounting data from missions.

Foreign Financial Statements

  • Ensure the technical drafting of foreign financial statements and manage relevant requests concerning financial reporting matters.
  • Provide technical support to the Missions regarding accounting requests received from external auditing firms.
  • Identify and propose methods and workflows to streamline the preparation and presentation of foreign financial statements.
  • Work in close coordination with the Archive & Docs Officer to support the quality of the electronic archive and verify the consistency of accounting data with the main archived official documents.

Archive

  • Work in close coordination with the Archive & Docs Officer to support the quality of the electronic archive and verify the consistency of accounting data with the main archived official documents.

Required profile and experience:

  • Technical diploma in Accounting and/or a University Degree in Economics and Business (or equivalent qualification).
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in a similar or relevant role.
  • Previous experience in the non-profit sector and knowledge of relevant Third Sector legislation is highly desirable.
  • Accounting & Bookkeeping: Strong knowledge of general accounting principles and double-entry bookkeeping.
  • Project Reporting: Proven experience in financial reporting for projects and grants funded by both public and private entities.
  • Administrative Documentation: Proficiency in managing administrative and accounting documents, including invoices, payments, bank statements, bank guarantees (fideiussioni), and insurance policies.
  • HR & Payroll Administration: Experience in handling payroll and HR-related documentation (pay slips, LUL, INPS, INAIL compliance, letters of appointment, and timesheets).
  • IT & Office Skills: Excellent command of Microsoft Excel and the MS Office suite.
  • Digital Platforms: Familiarity with online reporting portals and platforms.
  • Cloud Tools: Proficiency in using cloud-based shared storage and collaboration tools (e.g., Google Drive, OneDrive, SharePoint).
  • Good command of English is required; knowledge of French is considered a strong asset.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both internal and external stakeholders.

General conditions and benefits:

  • Accommodation: Accommodation is not applicable
  • R&R: Rest and Recuperation (R&R) is not applicable.
  • Annual Leave: 2.5 days per month
  • Medical insurance for the staff.
  • Induction: one week of online induction before the deployment
